scope: LocalCharts.actual_integral_denominator_inverse: polynomial equality for every rational z and formal inverse identity; no analytic convergence or bit-cost/recovery theorem.
statement: For every source scale a and source node m, the actual common denominator on the chart T=m-2^a+2^(a+1)z has a polynomial representative over the concrete rational two-adic integral subring and a formal power-series reciprocal over that same ring.
